question:
(a) Study the derivatives of the function
\[
f(x)=\frac{x+1}{(x-1)(x-7)}
\]
to make conclusions about the behaviour of the function as \(x\) ranges over all possible values for which the above formula for \(f(x)\) is meaningful.

(b) Use the information obtained in (a) to draw a rough sketch of the graph of \(f(x)\) on plain paper.
